config.arbitrator: EpisodicContrastiveArbitrator (prototypes/architecture-a/attention_ecr.py; subclasses AttentionArbitrator; attention.py UNTOUCHED; tick.py additive arbitrator_kwargs passthrough only)
config.frozen_condition: identical EpisodicContrastiveArbitrator with frozen=True (gains pinned at 1.0)
config.note: Every hyperparameter except the update rule is identical to K5 P1 (NR-A-006 baseline). The ONLY change under test is the gain-update rule. Rate params (shape_punish/prebranch_demote/corridor_boost) tuned on exploratory seeds 501-510; confirmatory seeds are fresh.
config.specialists: neutral (0.5 + noise(0.05) on every channel; bandit isolation, K5 P1 identical)

frozen_gates.G0: canonical files byte-identical pre/post (attention.py, bids.py, tick.py core path, delayed_reward.py)
frozen_gates.G2: determinism: recompute one seed, expect exact match

gate: PASS iff R >= 1.30 on 4/4 fresh seeds {21001, 21002, 21003, 21004}. Else FAIL -> negative result with mechanism.
hypothesis: H1: Replacing the constant-baseline delta rule (and K9's eligibility-trace rule) with the Episodic Contrastive Return (ECR) gain update lets learned gains beat frozen gains on canonical delayed_reward (R >= 1.30 on 4/4 fresh seeds). Mechanism: (1) episodic credit assignment -- episode boundaries detected from the reward stream alone (r>=1.0 terminal signal + max_steps truncation timeout); on success, the episode's branch choice AND the progress channel are SET to the gain cap (tied, so neither can dominate/poison t=0 -- the K9 failure mode); (2) shaping-tick demotion of provably-useless channels (stay suppressed, branches protected as enablers); (3) corridor boost for forward on shaping ticks (more forwards in corridor); (4) pre-branch demotion -- a non-branch winner before any branch was chosen is a wasted no-op, demoted ONLY down to the branch-gain level (negative feedback against t=0 poisoning without inverting into branch dominance).
metric: R = total_reward(learned) / total_reward(frozen) per seed, over the full 8-episode run (120 ticks max). Per-seed WIN iff R >= 1.30.
null: H0: ECR does not beat frozen gains (R < 1.30 on >= 1 of 4 seeds) -> the redesign fails -> new NR entry; NR-A-006 stands.
preregistered_before: any execution of the EXP-FP-0021 confirmatory driver on the preregistered seeds

documented_priors: max_steps (episode length bound, truncation detection only)
rule_summary.episode_boundary_detection: r>=1.0 (terminal) OR ep_ticks>=max_steps (truncation); reward-stream only, no env/obs read
rule_summary.predicted_failure_mode: If the rule fails, expected mechanism: (a) forward corridor-boost overpowers pre-branch demotion on some seed -> t=0 poisoning returns -> learned < frozen; or (b) shaping-noise on no-success seeds keeps R < 1.30. Gains trace will show which.

update_triggers.0 < r < 1.0: shaping: count toward progress-channel ID; demote non-{winner,branches} by 0.02; boost winner by 0.01
update_triggers.r == 0 and pre-branch and winner not in: demote winner by 0.05 down to branch level
update_triggers.r >= 1.0: successful episode: gain[branch_choice]=cap, gain[progress_channel]=cap; reset episode

title: Episodic Contrastive Return (ECR) gain redesign for sparse delayed reward
